sources._note: Only for readers whose punches live in attendance-software database (driver 'SQL Database' or 'WDMS'). Keyed by device name, serial, or '*'. Delete this block for ZKTeco readers polled over the LAN.

zkteco._note: Optional. Direct LAN connection to ZKTeco/eSSL terminals (LX50, K40, ...). Keyed by device name, serial or '*'. Test first with: python -m grohr_agent --probe-zk 192.168.1.201

profile._note: Optional. Answers GroHR profile requests (name + photo). Defaults are eSSL Easy Time Pro / BioTime.

easytime._note: Optional. Lets GroHR create/update/remove employees in eSSL Easy Time Pro (BioTime) through its REST API; it then sends them to the machines. Run --probe-easytime first. Keep dry_run true until the Dry Run results in GroHR look right.
